'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Vinayum Bari DS You Can Run''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vinayum Bari]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name I Saw it Burn. Unnamed Light d2p1_p19.png (2010 form, LIGHT checked). Name/username blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' DVDRCTS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
